gold.description: The ERB block closes with end if, which is invalid Ruby/ERB and will raise at render; it should just be end to close the if block.

candidate.title: Stray `if` in `<%- end if %>` makes the embed template fail to compile
candidate.description: ERB emits `end if` followed by output, so `end` closes the `posts.present?` conditional and bare `if` opens a new one never closed. Template raises `SyntaxError: unexpected end-of-input, expecting keyword_end` at compile time, causing 500 on GET /embed/best for embed URLs with topics. Fix: `<%- end %>` on line 6.

promotion_candidates.title: `poll_feed` crashes on plain RSS 2.0 feeds and the job never retries
promotion_candidates.description: `i.content` is only populated for Atom feeds; RSS 2.0 uses `<description>`, so `nil.scrub` raises `NoMethodError`. No per-item rescue and `retry: false` means first bad item aborts entire poll. Fix: handle both `i.content || i.description` and wrap per-item logic in begin/rescue.

promotion_candidates.title: `absolutize_urls` corrupts protocol-relative URLs and skips path-relative ones
promotion_candidates.description: `href.sub(/^/+/, '')` strips all leading slashes, converting `//cdn.example.com/img.png` to broken `http://blog.example.com/cdn.example.com/img.png`. Path-relative URLs like `images/wat.jpg` remain relative. Fix: use `URI.join(url, href).to_s` guarded by rescue.

promotion_candidates.title: Disqus importer silently drops thread dates and categories, and one dead link aborts the run
promotion_candidates.description: `TopicEmbed.import_remote` drops `created_at` and `category_id` that original `PostCreator.new` passed, stamping imported topics as "now" while replies keep historical dates. `open(url).read` with no rescue means one 404/timeout aborts entire import. Fix: pass fields through import chain and rescue per-thread calls.

promotion_candidates.title: Unused `require_dependency 'email/sender'` in the retrieve-topic job
promotion_candidates.description: Job touches `User` and `TopicRetriever` only; mail require is copy-paste that unnecessarily loads mail stack on every worker boot. Fix: delete line 1, keep `require_dependency 'topic_retriever'`.
